entities.summary: Tomi Joutsen (b. 1975-04-30, Lohja) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Lohja and Finland. Known in the fields of finland, composers & musicians, europe.
